_note: Frozen golden baseline of the OLD breadcrumb resolver (progression_breadcrumb.gd), captured from commit d5ca821 on 2026-10-20, before any Y1-P0-T05 edit. Algorithm: for every Chapter 2+ entry i of OBJECTIVES (from 'Travel to Ironhold' to the end), flags_i = every blocker/blocker_alt flag of entries 0..i-1, minus entry i's own blocker/blocker_alt, plus entry i's required flag; plus the flags of each CHAPTER_SELECT_DATA preset in scripts/main_menu.gd (set via GameManager.set_story_flag then normalize_source_key_progression, exactly as _launch_chapter does). Each set was applied after GameManager.reset_game() with current_state forced to EXPLORATION, then ProgressionBreadcrumb.force_refresh(); text/hint/has_target/target were read from get_current_objective(), _current_hint, _has_target, _target_position. 'flags' is the sorted list of every story flag that is true after setup. 'old_index' is the index in the PRE-T05 OBJECTIVES table (it will shift after T05; match on text). Sets whose old result was not a Chapter 2+ entry are listed under 'excluded'. Preset variants named 'preset+legacy_ch1_flags:<label>' add tutorial_completed and ch1_knight_killed (the legacy flags that release old entry 3 'Survive the crash site', which has no required flag, and old entry 4 'Defeat the Corrupted Sentinel'; the rewritten Chapter 1 route sets neither) because every plain preset is otherwise stuck on a stale Chapter 1 entry and would give no Chapter 2+ regression target. Presets whose flags lack ch1_complete still land on old Chapter 1 entry 5 and are excluded. Regenerate: not applicable, this is a frozen baseline (the old resolver no longer exists once T05 lands).
